svg.title: LumaScan ID card studio wireframe
svg.desc: Eight sanitized mobile wireframes showing shortcut entry, document type, front capture, back capture, review, layout, purpose watermark, and saved document states.
svg.text: A private, guided path from shortcut to a purpose-marked, export-ready copy. All identity content below is fictional.

g.text: Find the task without entering a generic camera first.
What would you like to capture?
Front + back, single side, or passport page.
Choose a format. Nothing is uploaded.
Mode-specific guidance with glare and edge checks.
Pair the second side without losing the first.
Check pairing, crop, rotation and sharpness.
A4/Letter safe area with true-size preview.
Optional, specific and visible before export.
One document, one page, reversible source sides.

svg.text: Source inspiration: eight private behavioral references in this folder. This original wireframe intentionally omits names, numbers, portraits, QR data and document imagery from those references.
